title: Exceptional-Point-Anchored Variational Quantum Eigensolver for Non-Hermitian Many-Body Phase Diagrams: Bridging Skin-Effect Topology and Entanglement Criticality on NISQ Hardware
summary: We introduce the Biorthogonal Variational Quantum Eigensolver (B-VQE), a quantum algorithm for simulating non-Hermitian many-body systems on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. Non-Hermitian quantum matter exhibits exceptional points, parity-time symmetry breaking, and non-Hermitian skin effects, yet existing quantum algorithms often rely on costly post-selection procedures and are not designed to capture biorthogonal eigenstates.
